CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed') , Tests_Failed__c = 0, Error_Message__c = '' ) , IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'IconsUtility/Passed.png', 'No issues', 30, 150) , IF( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed') ), IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'IconsUtility/Progress.png', 'In progress', 30, 150), IMAGE('/resource/'+$Setup.Credentials__c.Namespace__c+'IconsUtility/Failed.png', 'Issues found', 30, 150)))
CustomField.label: Result
